# Gemma 2B (base)

Google · released 2024-02 · 2.51B params · gemma

**score 29.9** ±0.6 · #495 of 551 · from 28 benchmark results across 5 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-2b/blob/9cf48e52b224239de00d483ec8eb84fb8d0f3a3a/README.md): Context length stated on the official model card.</sub>

<pre>
download        size  score
4-bit q4_k_m  ~1.8GB   29.9
8-bit q8_0    ~2.7GB   29.9
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run gemma:2b-text-q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run gemma:2b-text-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
